Tickets and Admission Policy: Third-party attraction tickets or city passes are not accepted for participation in the tour. All admission tickets must be purchased either during booking or directly from your tour guide on the day of the tour.
For a comfortable and enjoyable experience, we recommend bringing comfortable shoes, weather-appropriate clothing, a sun hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, cash, and drinks for hydration.

You must contact the tour operator at least 3 days prior to the departure date to provide the pick-up location. If no information is received by the deadline, the default pick-up location and time will be automatically assigned: 09:00am at DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Orlando at SeaWorld--10100 International Dr, Orlando, FL 32821；
For safety and communication purposes during the trip, a valid and reachable phone number is required for participants.

Children under 6 may require a booster seat by law. When traveling on the minivans or vans, booster seats may be needed. Please contact the tour operator in advance if needed. Rental service is also available upon request.
Please note: Cash is required during the tour for certain attractions, shops, and tickets. Guests are advised to prepare sufficient cash in advance.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Trade the city for untouched nature with a full-day trip to Silver Springs State Park, an oasis known for its crystal-clear waters and abundant wildlife. After convenient transportation from Orlando, you’ll have up to five hours to dive into a lineup of optional adventures; paddle a kayak along the Silver River, hop aboard the legendary Glass Bottom Boat for a surreal view of the springs, or explore miles of scenic hiking trails. From manatees drifting through transparent waters to lush forests once used as Hollywood backdrops, every part of Silver Springs feels like stepping into a postcard. This is the perfect outdoor escape for travelers craving freedom, beauty, and authentic Florida nature.
